contract.intent: Surface the DEFERRED work: a deferred task currently closes its leg and then vanishes from the pull surface — `ann next` says `journey exhausted` while an outstanding deferred obligation (with a recorded reason and a plan) exists. Make deferred work VISIBLE where the human steers: in `next` and `journey` (each deferred task: id · reason · where its plan lives) and in the UI. A derived read only — no new state, no new event, no new write path.
acceptanceCriteria: `ann next` (and the shared look-back) surfaces every outstanding deferred task: the id, its recorded `reason` (from the deferred event), and its plan pointer when one is named — as a distinct section/deferred line, never folded into 'no ready action' or the exhausted consult

`ann journey`'s WHAT IS AHEAD (or the leg lines) makes the same deferred obligation visible without breaking the existing state line; the UI's journey view shows the same (a deferred row/section or filter)

Derived only: no new event type, no new state, no new write path; the deferred status/leg-closure behaviour is UNCHANGED (a deferred task still closes its leg — this task is visibility, not semantics)

Proof by test: a journey with a deferred task renders it in next + journey (and the service route); the exhausted-journey case still reads honestly (the deferred obligation shown ALONGSIDE the goal consult, not instead of it); the no-deferred case is unchanged; full suite green; ann check/verify clean; committed with evidence
